After the one-time volunteer intro class, sign out a dog Saturdays 12-4pm for an outing, or on select Saturdays take one home overnight (pick up Sat 1-5pm, return Sun 4-6pm) with food, bed and leash provided.

Rules, hours and fees are set by the shelter and can change. Always confirm with the shelter before you go. ShelterDayOut isn't affiliated with this shelter and doesn't arrange outings.
